description_en: This topic provides an example on how to query the details of a remediation configuration whose ID is crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e\\\\
description_zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询修正设置crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e****的详情
kebab_example: aliyun config describe-remediation --config-rule-id cr-3184626622af0030000 --remediation-id crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRemediation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the remediation configuration
parameters.name: remediation_id

Remediation.description_en: The details of the remediation configuration

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

InvokeType.description_en:
The execution mode of the remediation template. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation template was not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation template was automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation template was manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode was not specified
InvokeType.description_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。

AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。

MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。

NOT_CONFIG：未设置

LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_en: The record ID of the last successful execution of the remediation template
LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的记录ID

LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last successful execution of the remediation template. Unit: milliseconds
LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的时间戳。单位：毫秒

LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_en:
The mode of the last successful execution of the remediation template. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation template was not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation template was automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation template was manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode was not specified
